evals.prompt: I'm adding NATS to my Nuxt 4 app using the nuxt-nats module. I need to connect to a 3-node production cluster with JWT+NKey auth (secrets come from env, not the repo), and publish an 'orders.created' event from a server API route with type safety and deduplication. Show me the nuxt.config setup and the publish code.
evals.expected_output: nuxt.config nats: block with servers + provision:'never', auth via env (NUXT_NATS_USER_JWT + NUXT_NATS_NKEY_SEED), a server/api route using jsPublish('orders.created', data, { msgId }), and a NatsEvents .d.ts augmentation for type safety. Notes passing all cluster nodes.

assertions.text: Configures the module via the nats: key in nuxt.config (not raw @nats-io client setup)
Uses env-var injected auth (NUXT_NATS_USER_JWT + NUXT_NATS_NKEY_SEED) rather than hardcoding creds in config
Publishes with jsPublish and sets msgId for dedup (Nats-Msg-Id)
Adds NatsEvents interface augmentation (import type {} from 'nuxt-nats') for typed subjects
Publishes from server-side (server/api or server/**), not a Vue component/composable
Passes all cluster nodes (comma-separated NUXT_NATS_SERVERS) and/or uses provision:'never' for prod

evals.prompt: In my nuxt-nats app I have a durable pull consumer for 'orders.created' but it's not receiving anything in production even though the logs show NATS connected fine. It also needs to retry transient failures and dead-letter poison messages. What am I missing, and what should the consumer look like?
evals.expected_output: Diagnose the missing NUXT_NATS_WORKERS=true worker gate (and/or consumer declared in server/workers instead of server/plugins). Provide a defineNatsConsumer in a server plugin with nak(delay) for transient / term for poison, and defineDeadLetterConsumer for the DLQ (advisory capture, since NATS has no built-in DLQ).

assertions.text: Identifies the NUXT_NATS_WORKERS=true worker gate as the reason consumers don't run (or server/plugins vs server/workers registration)
Uses defineNatsConsumer registered in a Nitro server plugin
Distinguishes transient (nak with delay) from poison (term) handling — and warns bare nak() burns deliveries
States NATS has no built-in DLQ; max_deliver = retry then stop (not auto-route to a DLQ)
Uses defineDeadLetterConsumer (or advisory-capture into a stream) for dead-lettering, not a core NATS subscription

evals.prompt: I want to expose my Nuxt app as a discoverable AI agent on the NATS bus using nuxt-nats — it should stream tokens back to the caller and ask the user to confirm before doing anything destructive. Show me the agent code and how another service would call it.
evals.expected_output: A defineNatsAgent in a server plugin with an onPrompt handler that streams via response.send and confirms via response.ask(prompt,{timeoutMs}); notes the NUXT_NATS_WORKERS gate; and a caller using useAgents().discover() + agent.prompt() iterating typed chunks.

assertions.text: Uses defineNatsAgent with an onPrompt(envelope, response) handler
Streams tokens with repeated response.send(...) calls
Implements human-in-the-loop confirmation with response.ask(prompt, { timeoutMs }) (NOT response.query)
Notes the agent runs only when NUXT_NATS_WORKERS=true
Shows a caller using useAgents().discover() then agent.prompt() iterating chunks
